content.value_statement: Teams often need consistent Anthropic-style colors and typography across generated artifacts. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear styling rules for visual work.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic brand color values for dark, light, gray, and accent colors.
Defines heading and body typography choices with fallback fonts.
Guides color selection for text, backgrounds, shapes, and accents.
Supports consistent styling for presentations, documents, and visual artifacts.
Explains how RGB values can be applied through python-pptx.
limitations: Does not include downloadable font files or install fonts automatically.
Does not verify legal approval for public brand usage.
Does not provide scripts that transform files by itself.
Depends on the host tool to apply the guidance correctly.

use_cases.title: Style a Client Presentation
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent Anthropic-inspired palette, heading style, and accent treatment to presentation slides.

use_cases.title: Format Internal Documentation
use_cases.description: Use defined colors and typography to make internal documents visually consistent across teams.

use_cases.title: Guide Generated Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Give an AI assistant concrete brand styling rules before it creates diagrams, reports, or handouts.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple artifact refresh.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand guidelines to this document. Use the defined colors, heading font, body font, and readable contrast.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a presentation update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this presentation with the brand palette. Use accent colors for shapes and keep headings visually distinct from body text.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brand-Aligned Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new formatted deliverable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise report using these brand guidelines. Include clear headings, balanced accent colors, and readable text hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Brand Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for review and correction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this artifact for brand consistency. Identify mismatched colors, typography issues, weak contrast, and specific styling fixes.

output_examples.input: Restyle a four-slide product overview with the brand palette.
output_examples.output: The slides use dark text on light backgrounds, Poppins-style headings, Lora-style body text, and orange, blue, and green accents.

output_examples.input: Check whether a document follows the brand guidance.
output: Body text uses the correct serif style.
Accent colors are consistent across callouts and shapes.
One gray background needs stronger contrast.

output_examples.input: Generate a one-page handout with brand-aligned styling.
output_examples.output: The handout uses a light background, dark primary text, restrained accent colors, and clear heading hierarchy.

best_practices: Provide the artifact type and audience before asking for styling changes.
Ask for a contrast check when applying dark backgrounds or gray text.
Use accent colors sparingly for emphasis, status, or section separation.
anti_patterns: Do not use every accent color in every section.
Do not replace brand guidance with unrelated color palettes.
Do not assume public trademark or brand approval from visual consistency alone.

faq.question: Does this skill install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora with common fallback fonts when they are unavailable.

faq.question: Can it edit PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: It provides styling guidance for tools that can edit presentations, including python-pptx based workflows.

faq.question: Does it include official legal approval?
faq.answer: No. Users should confirm brand permissions before publishing external or commercial materials.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What colors does it define?
faq.answer: It defines dark, light, two gray tones, and orange, blue, and green accent colors.

faq.question: Is this a code execution skill?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a Markdown guideline document and does not include executable scripts.
